name: claw-kit
description: Cindy workflow tools, lifecycle guidance, and Skills for claw-kit.
whenToUse: Use for Cindy sessions that need claw-kit plan, task, subplan, or workflow operations.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List the available claw-kit workflow operations. Omit category for an overview, or pass a category to see operation names, descriptions, and argument schemas.

category.description: Optional operation category returned by a previous overview.

tools.name: call_tool
tools.description: Run one claw-kit workflow operation in the current Cindy session. Use a name returned by list_tools and pass only that operation''s JSON arguments; Cindy supplies the session and workspace identity.

items.name: using-claw-kit
items.description: Use first whenever the claw-kit Cindy plugin is enabled or its start prompt is present; check your available tools and follow the matching execution route.

items.name: planning
items.description: Use when a planning step needs to refine a user request into clear requirements, scope, completion criteria, dependencies, and executable tasks, especially when task boundaries or an evidence-dependent route still need judgment.

items.name: researcher
items.description: Delegate code investigation, source inspection, symbol or dependency tracing, code architecture analysis, and current implementation behavior analysis to a focused researcher subagent. Reuse a related researcher already available in the same thread.
